pairing: One independent innovation sequence per replicate is reused across all 24 diagnostic cells; differences in AR order filter the same innovations. Pooling, nuisance and censor comparisons are paired. Each cell has 512 independent replicates; there are 512 independent diagnostic innovation blocks, not 12288 independent experiments. Short confirmation pooling cells share 2048 fresh blocks; long confirmation has a separate 2048-block stream.
